Fix-round 4: corrected the locality paragraph. The UI proxy forwards every non-GET (lifecycle.ts uiRequestHandler), so ingest POSTs work on the UI port and through Tailscale Serve; a GET to /v1 is not forwarded. A loopback client relayed by the proxy counts as local; Serve requests are remote via the proxy's forwarded Host and forwarding-evidence marker. Pinned by telemetry-producer-ui-proxy-transport.test.ts over real sockets.
